summary_1line: Rama and Ravana’s duel intensifies; Rama repeatedly severs Ravana’s regenerating heads while the cosmos trembles and gods watch anxiously.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama’s arrow slices off Ravana’s jeweled head, which falls to the earth as another head instantly grows from the demon king’s body.
The two chariots halt face to face with shafts touching, horses pressing forward while Rama and Ravana fire torrents of arrows at point-blank range.
Gods and sages crowd the sky in alarm as the earth trembles, seas roar, and the darkened sun watches Rama battle Ravana below.
